scope: Exhaustive named entries within five selected primary source modules, with supporting event declarations/wiring and package-entry metadata. Bounded P1-03 slice; not full coding-agent/product inventory or phase completion.

provenance.method: Read-only source inspection/extraction from git show <pinned commit>:<path>; each consulted checkout file byte-compared with canonical Git blob before enumeration. No source transforms, source execution, build, installed dependency evaluation, paid calls or network calls.
provenance.sourceHashPolicy: SHA-256 over exact canonical Git blob bytes; Git blob IDs recorded separately; checkout byte identity required.
provenance.sourceLocations: One-based lines and zero-based character offsets in canonical UTF-8 text. A short location identifies the declaration/control-flow anchor, not exhaustive implementation review.
provenance.staticReviewChecks: All row ids, source hashes/line offsets, ownership/phase/test obligations and Deferred/no-execution evidence flags verified; named parser/union/export enumeration counts recorded. These are metadata checks, not implementation or behavior tests.

remainingInventory.work: Dedicated package/config/auth/MCP command parsers and handlers; all subcommand flags, exit codes, help/version/output, interactive slash handlers, keybindings, config/environment precedence and resources. Names observed only in printHelp remain declarations.

RpcClient/RPC entry artifact, every nested DTO member and runtime malformed-input shape, output guard, runtime operation effects, event reachability/order, concurrent generation/settlement, extension UI cancellation and unknown outcome; genuine upstream/native differential corpus.

Every SDK export defining module, overload/member/return/error/lifetime contract, released JS/declaration root artifacts, and separately declared ./client, ./experimental/plugin and ./rpc-entry exports. Root type syntax is not runtime artifact verification.

Real dynamic extension/prompt/skill commands and extension flag registrations/collisions/visibility per pinned corpus, full native C# SDK member inventory and required MCP/codemode capabilities. No arbitrary name list or scope exclusion.
Reconcile this slice into existing surfaces/parity/provenance/profile/checker files under parent ownership; expand all remaining required families. Pending inventory is not Out of scope or Supported.
